title: Chinese Face Solo #35 (중국 · 30대 · 고혹적인 · 메이크업 없음 · 피어싱 P15+쥬얼리 · 마이크로더멀 자수정 별 · 스티커 금박 별(관자놀이) · 각도 고개 살짝 기울임 · 점 눈물점+입술점)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head tilted a little to one side, her eyes looking straight into the camera, both ears clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese poised refined beauty luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, a polished low bun with a few loose strands. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a small dark beauty mark just below the outer corner of her left eye like a tear mole, a second tiny beauty mark above the right corner of her upper lip, each one a clearly visible dot of real skin pigment, microdermal amethyst-purple star-shaped gems pressed deep into the skin: a row of five small gems along each cheekbone and one larger gem at the center of the forehead, each gem sitting on a tiny hidden metal base implanted beneath the skin and pressing firmly down so the skin around every gem is visibly pushed in, forming a clear small dimple with a soft raised ring of flesh bulging around its edge, a small natural warm shadow in each dimple, calm healthy skin with no redness or swelling, all gems well clear of the eyes and clear of the piercings, four small gold foil star stickers, two at each temple, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, a slow, lingering gaze, lips closed in a restrained knowing half-smile, an alluring, mature, magnetic expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: On each ear four pieces: a big copper bar in the lobe, a smaller copper ring above it, a thick copper bar and a small copper stud at the top; a small copper ring passes through each nostril; a thin copper bar passes through the outer end of each eyebrow; a copper hoop passes through the lower lip's edge; a copper labret stud sits beneath the lower lip with a small copper ring below it. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal. All jewelry is real copper, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears a single piece of mixed-metal necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and a single piece of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal and every gem read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
